jei.info.elemenic_channel: The Elemenic Channel is the conduit for elemenix transportation, used to connect an Elemenic Outlet to elemenix-input blocks. The Elemenic Channel has a strict flow direction; an incorrect direction will break the flow.
jei.info.elemenic_deconstructor: The Elemenic Deconstructor is used to automatically deconstruct items placed inside it. The elemenix obtained can be transferred to other devices using an Elemenic Outlet. When it receives a redstone signal, its deconstruction function is locked.
jei.info.elemenic_ejector: The Elemenic Ejector is an integration of the Elemenic Deconstructor and the Elemenic Enricher. It can automatically deconstruct items and enrich the obtained elemenix into essence. Meanwhile, the enriched essence is automatically ejected as item drops. Use a Throttle Valve and a Flow Straightener to control its ejection behavior.
jei.info.elemenic_enricher: The Elemenic Enricher can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and enrich the stored elemenix into the corresponding essence. When it receives a redstone signal, its enriching function is locked.
jei.info.elemenic_infuser: The Elemenic Infuser can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and transfer the stored elemenix into an Elemenic Analyzer or Elemenic Storage. When it receives a redstone signal, its infusion function is locked. Additionally, the Elemenic Infuser can establish a remote connection with a Remote Elemenic Storage to remotely access the elemenix stored in it.
jei.info.elemenic_outlet: The Elemenic Outlet is the starting point of elemenix transportation. It extracts elemenix from elemenix-output blocks and transfers it to elemenix-input devices through Elemenic Channels. When it receives a redstone signal, its transportation function is locked. Players can click to open the outlet screen and adjust the maximum output per operation for each elemenix type.
jei.info.elemenic_scanner: The Elemenic Scanner is used to scan and calculate the total elemenix of all items in a container block, and display it to the player.
jei.info.elemenic_storage: The Elemenic Storage is used to temporarily hold elemenix stored by the elemenic infuser, and can also establish a connection with a remote elemenic storage. When needed, the player can transfer the elemenix from the storage into an analyzer, using a method similar to deconstructing items.
jei.info.elemenic_tank: The Elemenic Tank can receive and store elemenix through Elemenic Channels, and transfer the stored elemenix to other elemenix containers through an Elemenic Outlet.
jei.info.flow_straightener: The Flow Straightener restricts the ejection sequence of the elemenic ejector. When installed, the ejector will launch the stored elemenic essence from left to right. Additionally, an ejector equipped with a flow straightener can perform enrichment and ejection simultaneously.
jei.info.geological_simulator: The Geological Simulator is an Elemenic Transformer that oxidizes Metallix into Terrix using Flumix by simulating geological processes. The Geological Simulator can automatically deconstruct the pure Flumix items and pure Metallix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Flumix and Metallix into Terrix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Terrix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Terrix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the Mineralizing Mode can be enabled to combine mineral items and rock-type blocks into their corresponding ore blocks, a process that consumes Flumix.
jei.info.germinal_accelerator: The Germinal Accelerator is an Elemenic Transformer that provides the environment necessary for the genesis of life, cultivating Flumix and Terrix into living Organix. The Germinal Accelerator can automatically deconstruct the pure Terrix items and pure Flumix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Terrix and Flumix into Organix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Organix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Organix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the Germinating Mode can be enabled to use a plant-type item as a gene template to obtain all its related natural derivatives, a process that consumes Flumix and Terrix.
jei.info.memory_burner: The Memory Burner is used to edit the item sequence stored in a memorizer. It allows for operations such as moving, swapping, and deleting items, and supports copying or merging the list to another memorizer.
jei.info.metallurgical_activator: The Metallurgical Activator is an Elemenic Transformer capable of reducing Terrix back into Metallix using the immense energy contained within Energix. The Metallurgical Activator can automatically deconstruct the pure Terrix items and pure Energix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Terrix and Energix into Metallix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Metallix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Metallix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet. Additionally, the Imitforging Mode can be enabled to replace the appearance of a specific type of item with another item's appearance, a process that consumes Energix.
jei.info.optical_capturer: The Optical Capturer is an Elemenic Transformer. It accelerates the photosynthesis of Organix using Flumix, converting the captured light energy into Energix. The Optical Capturer can automatically deconstruct the pure Organix items and pure Flumix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Organix and Flumix into Energix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Energix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Energix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet.
jei.info.remote_elemenic_storage: The Remote Elemenic Storage is used to remotely access elemenix from an elemenic storage. This item does not directly store any elemenix itself; it merely provides the player with a method to transfer the elemenix reserves without having to retrieve the physical storage unit.
jei.info.scanning_storage: The Scanning Storage can quickly deconstruct all items in a container block and store them. This process is also considered as opening the container, which can trigger the opening effects of special containers such as trapped chests.
jei.info.throttle_valve: The Throttle Valve is used in the elemenic ejector to limit the maximum number of items ejected per launch. When held in the player's main hand, right-click to adjust the valve's opening level.
jei.info.transpiring_incinerator: The Transpiring Incinerator is an Elemenic Transformer. Using the thermal energy provided by Energix, it intensifies the transpiration process of Organix, generating large amounts of Flumix. The Transpiring Incinerator can automatically deconstruct the pure Organix items and pure Energix items placed inside it to obtain elemenix, and can also receive elemenix through Elemenic Channels. When the transforming function is enabled, the device automatically converts Organix and Energix into Flumix; when the enriching function is enabled, the resulting Flumix is automatically enriched into essence. The resulting Flumix can also be output through an Elemenic Outlet.
